items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Johnnie Simpson was the one who taught me how to play the guitar.

ctx.x: Well I was going to ask a little bit more about your life. How old were you when you first took up music?
Well I started to play when I was around. Johnnie Simpson was the one who taught me how to play the guitar. Well he started. When I got away from it, you see what I mean? I was around nine years old.
Did you say your first instrument then was guitar or the plectum banjo?
